title: National Law Enforcement Museum Exhibits Act
official_summary:
National Law Enforcement Museum Exhibits Act

(Sec. 2) This bill amends the National Law Enforcement Museum Act to permit the National Law Enforcement Museum in Washington, DC, to acquire, receive, possess, collect, ship, transport, import, and display firearms in fulfilling the museum's purposes.

summary.headline: A 2018 law lets the National Law Enforcement Museum in Washington, DC, acquire, possess, ship, import, and display firearms for its exhibits.
summary.what_it_does: This law amends the National Law Enforcement Museum Act. It gives the museum permission to acquire, receive, collect, possess, ship, transport, import, and display firearms. The permission applies only when the museum is carrying out its purposes. The official summary does not describe any other details.

who_it_affects.group: The National Law Enforcement Museum in Washington, DC
who_it_affects.how: The museum can now obtain and handle firearms as part of its exhibits and collection work.
Visitors may see firearms in the museum's displays.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when the President signed it into law on December 17, 2018.
